rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2BA grade and gives reasonable ICM/TE descriptions, but includes likely fabricated image-specific details such as zona pellucida uniformity and a somewhat confusing blastocoel description ('fully filled, ~50% volume').

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, prior failed cycles, semen, BMI, endometrium, and embryo grade into prognosis well, though some links are overstated and not all factors are equally evidence-based.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear prognosis pathway, but some quantitative adjustments are arbitrary and a few claims (e.g., alcohol and stress effects, exact decrement values) are stronger than the evidence presented.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, transfer appropriateness, and age-related aneuploidy discussion, but recommendations such as ERA, thrombophilia screening, and NK cell assessment are not routine guideline-based after this history and are presented too readily.

Provides clear next steps for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, lifestyle modification, and future planning, though some suggested investigations/interventions are more speculative than standard.
